description: Compares Irish net take-home pay, rent, employer pension/superannuation, 3-year cash savings, and time required to save a €50,000 home deposit across 7 global cities (Dublin, Cork/Galway, Sydney, London, Dubai, Toronto, Amsterdam) for Irish careers (Nurse, Teacher, Software Engineer, Accountant, Electrician) — powered by emigrate.datalab.broc.fi.

customDublinSalaryEur.description: Optional custom Dublin gross salary in EUR to scale international peer salaries proportionally.

seniorityMultiplier.description: Pay scale multiplier across all cities (0.75 junior to 1.5 senior, default 1.0).
